description: Semantic search over a small curated corpus: Scopeweb's own documentation and methodology, ICANN policy, and per-registry policy documents. Returns passages with the source, its URL, and what that source may be cited for. For explaining how something works. It is retrieval, not authority: a vector search always returns its nearest neighbour, so a returned passage is not evidence that it answers the question. Per-registry policy fields and current registration status have their own sources, which take precedence over a passage here. Read-only. Cannot spend money.
name: kb_search
